blockers.detail: The frozen CPU energy track specifies the sensor, 1000 ms cadence, physical boundary, workload/collector affinity and qualification evidence, but does not freeze formal energy contexts, repetitions, run order, warm-up/window orchestration or an authoritative formal energy runner. The only frozen PDH sampler hard-codes formal_measurement=false and invalid_for_claims=true. Inferring or adding these fields after authorization would invent scientific parameters.

The frozen Phase-2 rule requires same-platform T_b and exact-admissible V_2. It says these will be collected after Phase 1 under a frozen addendum, but no such addendum or 358H T_b/V_2 formal inputs exist. Their measurement contexts, repetitions, warm-up/timing boundaries and run order cannot be inferred without changing the frozen design.
